official_scope: Develop an educational game using NASA open datasets to teach sustainable agricultural practices.
prototype_scope: A deterministic two-turn CLI learning sketch with crop choice, water/budget game units and resource catalog; synthetic weather only, not a validated agricultural model.

claims.text: The requested solution is an educational game using NASA open data; a catalog alone does not meet that full scope.
claims.uncertainty: Interpretation of scope is grounded in the explicit Summary and Objectives; no eligibility decision is asserted.

claims.text: The challenge explicitly calls attention to dataset limitations and farming context.
claims.uncertainty: Dataset product-specific limits remain to be researched.

claims.text: NASA lists Egypt-based Zumorroda-X as the 2025 Art & Technology winner for this challenge, describing farming mini games across environmental scenarios.
claims.uncertainty: No unpublished judge scores, causal reason for winning or independently verified game outcomes are available here.

claims.text: A small resource catalog could help explain the provenance behind a future game, but needs to become part of playable learning scenarios.
claims.uncertainty: AI design hypothesis; not a user preference or an established learning benefit.

claims.text: Judging first checks minimum requirements, then uses a holistic 1-5 assessment guided by impact, creativity, validity, relevance and presentation. No numeric criterion weights are provided.
claims.uncertainty: This is a bounded summary, not an exhaustive eligibility audit.

decisions.original: Potentially position the catalog as the competition entry.
decisions.revised: Keep the catalog as a bounded research prototype and leave official game requirements unmet.
decisions.reason: Official challenge scope requires an educational game.
decisions.message_ref: AI-authored example design; no user approval represented.

decisions.revised: Add two-turn crop/water/budget learning sketch with clearly synthetic rules.

minimum_requirements_summary: Primarily English; responds to selected challenge.
Demo up to 7 slides including opening/ending OR up to 30 seconds.
Accessible unrestricted links; use NASA open data/resources.
Declare AI-generated work, follow the listed branding and media disclosure rules.
prototype_unmet_or_unverified: Only resource metadata is used; no meaningful observation-driven farming model.
No official registration, team eligibility, event-time work or submission verification.
No final official-format demo or public link accessibility audit.
No scientific validity, learning outcome or real user usability study.
